run_no_pose_pred_ablation: run the fillerbuster training pipeline with pose prediction disabled using the no-pose-pred subcommand
run_random_pose_aug_ablation: run the fillerbuster training pipeline with random ray augmentation center and rotate modes enabled
run_no_index_embeddings_ablation: run the fillerbuster training pipeline with transformer index positional embeddings disabled using the no-index-embeddings subcommand
run_fixed_index_embeddings_ablation: run the fillerbuster training pipeline with fixed transformer index positional embeddings using the fixed-index-embeddings subcommand
run_final_model_training: run the fillerbuster final model training with fixed index embeddings and many training steps using the final subcommand
